_meta.purpose: Wider labelled test set for comparing LLM and JEV lead filter-and-score decisions across different targets.
_meta.status: DRAFT labels proposed by Claude on 2026-10-21. Business review required before results are trusted.
_meta.source: Synthetic. All people and companies are fictional; any resemblance to real people is coincidental. Safe to keep in Git.
_meta.use: Load as the directory with DIRECTORY_FILE=lead_scoring_scenarios.json. Score each scenario only against its own lead_keys. Report holdout scenarios separately and never tune question rules against them.

label_meaning.match: Should be selected for this scenario.
label_meaning.no_match: Should not be selected (wrong role, location, experience, department or seniority, or an excluded place).
label_meaning.borderline: Depends on a policy choice listed in open_questions; excluded from accuracy until decided.

_meta.ids: expected.directory_id is the id the backend assigns (company_id:index). key is stable for reviewers.
open_questions: Unknown fields (experience, location or level not supplied): include with benefit of the doubt, or exclude? Both current paths include them. They are labelled borderline here until you decide.
Experience bands that only partly fit (for example "6 to 10 years" against 3-8): include or exclude?
More senior titles than requested (Marketing Director for Marketing Manager, Senior VP for VP, Chief People Officer for HR Director): include?
Managers of the requested role (Engineering Manager, Nursing Unit Manager): include?
Adjacent roles (Software Engineer in Test, Machine Learning Engineer, Head of HR): include?
"Not in New York": the city only, or the whole state?

scenarios.query: Software engineers in the United States with 5+ years of experience
scenarios.covers: Individual-contributor role (not leadership), minimum experience, US metro areas without a country

scenarios.query: HR directors in the United Kingdom, excluding London
scenarios.covers: Excluded location inside a target country, London boroughs and Greater London, HR title variants

scenarios.query: People in the Sales department at Director or Vice President seniority in Canada
scenarios.covers: Explicit department and management-level fields, field contradicting a sales-sounding title

scenarios.query: Marketing managers in Germany or France with between 3 and 8 years of experience
scenarios.covers: Two countries, experience range with a maximum, regions without a country, manager-level role
Founder/CEO variants, cities inside India (including Mumbai), India/Indiana and founder-office traps
Unrelated domain (healthcare), suburb inside an excluded city, student and recruiter traps

scenarios.query: Data scientists in the United States or Canada with at most 4 years of experience, not in New York
scenarios.covers: Maximum experience, exclusion where "New York" may mean the city or the state, adjacent roles
